## Workload

Lena Fischer completed 539 reads during 342 hours of grading activity. This represents an average rate of 1.6 reads per hour. The workload figure reflects the total reading activity recorded for the review period and provides the basis for assessing the pace of work.

## Quality

A total of 35 reads were checked as part of the quality review. The recorded agreement rate was 77.1 per cent. This result should be considered alongside the workload information, including the total number of reads completed and the hours recorded.

The review was completed by Priya Anand, with Lena Fischer identified as the grader. The workload and quality measures are presented together to support the review of grading activity and agreement.
